# GitHub Copilot CLI Instructions for ASDLC

- **Framework**: ASDLC (AI-Software-Development-Life-Cycle) Enterprise SDK.
- **Workflow**:
  1. Check phase status using `asdlc status`.
  2. For incoming issues, run `asdlc triage <file>`.
  3. Verify documents against The Meisters Council using `asdlc review <doc>`.
  4. Ensure all code adheres to the 3-layer context (Governance > Catalog > User Prompt).
- Refer to `docs/charter/MEISTERS_CHARTER.md` for quality criteria.
